name: abap-monorepo-builder
description: ZMONO - easy way to create a monorepo from a systems abap source

scripts.unit: node -e "fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('output',{recursive:true,force:true})" && abap_transpile && echo RUNNING && node output/index.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --esModuleInterop --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target esnext --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions scripts/*.ts .opencode/tools/*.ts
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:ci && npm run unit

author: Philipp Doelker
